info.name: The Griffin API keys Transactions API

params.name: page[before]
params.description: A base64 encoded opaque string returned in paginated responses.

params.name: page[after]
params.description: A base64 encoded opaque string returned in paginated responses.

params.name: include
params.description: For each transaction returned, include its payment (if one exists) in the response under the `included` attribute.

params.name: filter[processed-at][lte]
params.description: Return only transactions processed at or before the given timestamp.

params.name: filter[processed-at][lt]
params.description: Return only transactions processed before the given timestamp.

params.name: filter[processed-at][gte]
params.description: Return only transactions processed at or after the given timestamp.

params.name: filter[processed-at][gt]
params.description: Return only transactions processed after the given timestamp.

items.docs: Lists transactions on a bank account. Use an `Accept: application/vnd.griffin+xero-csv` header to receive transactions in a CSV format suitable for importing into [Xero](https://central.xero.com/s/article/Import-a-CSV-bank-statement).
